headlines.title: Nvidia stock falls after company opens probe into CEO’s relationship with Chinese spy
headlines.description: Nvidia’s stock slid after the company announced that it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Jordon Hudson sues Airbnb hosts, blaming them for shirtless Bill Belichick video
headlines.description: Airbnb hosts violated the privacy of Bill Belichick’s former girlfriend Jordon Hudson by leaking doorbell video of her shirtless, Super Bowl-winning boyfriend.

headlines.title: Nvidia opens investigation after CEO’s affair with alleged Chinese spy
headlines.description: Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an employee memo. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

headlines.title: Fall Maintenance: Tips to Save You Money on Unexpected Repairs
headlines.description: As colder months near and temperatures drop, now is a good time to tackle home and car maintenance that can lower bills, prevent costly repairs and save you from major overhauls during the winter. A new report says 85 percent of homeowners paid for repairs they did not expect in 2025, so NBC's Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to share tips and tricks to make sure this season doesn't cost you.

headlines.title: Hiring Strengthens and Gas Prices Set to Come Down
headlines.description: After its post-election roller coaster ride on Wall Street, the markets enter a new week with a lot of questions. It comes as hiring accelerated in October and as gas prices are set to dip. What do the numbers signify for the months ahead? NBC chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY to break it all down.

headlines.title: Holiday Shopping Scams: How AI is Changing the Game
headlines.description: It’s the time of year when fraudsters get ready to take advantage of consumers, and according to a report from Norton, 88% of those who have fallen victim to a holiday shopping scam lost about $400. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY with the tactics being used this year, how AI is coming into play and tips to avoid scams including setting a secret code word and more.

headlines.title: U.S. adds 165,000 jobs in October, unemployment rate drops to 4.1%
headlines.description: The U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, a surprise that far outpaced expectations by economists and analysts. The unemployment rate in October dropped to 4.1%, extending a near-historically low streak. NBC News' Christine Romans and editor-in-chief at Investopedia, Caleb Silver, break down the latest data from the jobs market.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Investors try to regain their footing after tech stocks tank
headlines.description: Tech stocks in the U.S. steadied Friday after suffering one of their worst routs in years, as investors weighed the prospect of an AI investment slowdown.

headlines.title: The U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, a bright spot for the economy
headlines.description: The U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, a surprisingly strong number that includes what appear to be some AI-related construction and manufacturing jobs.

headlines.title: Stocks plunge as election outcome and AI worries crush tech shares
headlines.description: Shares in technology companies plunged, compounding declines and sparking concerns about the durability of artificial intelligence boom.

headlines.title: Wave of bomb threats against European airliners triggers diversions and tarmac searches
headlines.description: No explosives have been found, and it isn’t clear who or what is behind the calls, but the threats alone have caused chaos in the skies and airports.
